_comment: Copy to config.json and add your Claude Max accounts. The rotator does NOT ship with any accounts — you opt in by populating this file via /ops:rotate add-account or by editing it directly. See README.md for details.

_account_schema_example.label: optional-disambiguator
_account_schema_example.orgName: Required Workspace or Personal Account Name

rateLimits.note: Max 20x defaults: ~220K tokens / ~900 messages per 5h window. extraUsageSafetyMargin: accounts with paid overage enabled rotate at 75% of their threshold to avoid incurring charges.

_magicLinkGmailAccount_note: Single Gmail inbox that ALL accounts' Claude magic-link login emails forward to. The rotator polls only this inbox (via gog --account) for every account's link, then disambiguates by target email. Leave unset to poll each account's own mailbox. Real value belongs in the gitignored override config or CLAUDE_ROT_GMAIL_ACCOUNT / GOG_ACCOUNT env, never here.

rotation._comment: Optional rotation tunables. Multi-account seats and OAuth seat management run through CLIProxyAPI; this block holds only the rotator's own settings. A pre-existing "crs" block from an older install is still read.
rotation._stateDir_note: Optional absolute path (no ~ expansion) for reconciler state files. Defaults to <plugin-data-dir>/account-rotation if unset.
rotation._proxy_note: Per-account egress proxy for the captcha cascade. Set CLAUDE_ROTATION_PROXY_ENABLED=1 with EFG_PROXY_URL or BRIGHTDATA_PROXY_URL, or configure providers here. Credentials never live in this file.
rotation._enableMagicLinkRecovery_note: Deprecated and fail-closed. Unattended reauthentication is disabled; use the signed staged-enrollment workflow. No environment variable re-enables direct auth writes.
rotation._magicLinkRetryCooldownMs_note: Minimum time between unattended retry attempts for the SAME account, success or failure, so a persistently-broken account isn't retried in a tight loop (default 6h).
rotation._magicLinkDispatch_note: Retained for config compatibility only. The autoloop never dispatches authentication; staged enrollment is required.
rotation._magicLinkHeaded_note: Pass CLAUDE_ROT_HEADED=1 to the rotate child (default true). Interactive captcha walls need a headed browser on CLAUDE_DESKTOP_DISPLAY. Override with $CLAUDE_ROT_HEADED=0 only for pure headless experiments.
rotation._magicLinkRotateTimeoutMs_note: Wall-clock ms before the autoloop kills a stuck rotate child (default 20m). Override with $CLAUDE_REAUTH_TIMEOUT_MS. Captcha cascade (visual + desktop-act) needs more room than a pure token refresh.
